# Pinned so that a rebuild six months from now produces the same image. An unpinned FastAPI is
# how a working deployment starts failing at a version bump nobody chose.

fastapi==0.115.6
uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0
pydantic==2.10.4
pydantic-settings==2.7.0

# The Gemini SDK. Pulled in for both Vertex AI and the API-key path; which is used is decided by
# whether a key is configured, not by which library is installed.
google-genai==1.3.0
google-auth==2.37.0

# Server-sent events are generated by hand in this service rather than by a library, because the
# event shape is part of the contract with the Windows client and there are four kinds of it.
# Only the HTTP client is needed, for the Vertex Vector Search REST calls.
httpx==0.28.1

# Token handling. Chosen for a maintained, audited implementation of HS256 rather than a
# hand-rolled one.
PyJWT==2.10.1

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tests only
# Listed here so that `pip install -r requirements.txt` gives a working development environment.
# The Dockerfile installs this file and then uninstalls these two, so they are in the build
# layer but not in the running image.
pytest==8.3.4
pytest-asyncio==0.25.0
